customer_reply:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out. The error E-3310 occurs when there is a mismatch between the buyer tenant's SSO/SAML configuration and the supplier portal trust relationship. 

To resolve this, please follow these steps:
1. Verify if your SSO/SAML configuration was updated recently (Admin > Security > SSO history).
2. Follow the steps in KB-7889 to re-establish the supplier portal trust relationship.
3. Ask the affected suppliers to sign out, clear their browser session, and attempt to resubmit their bids.

Since your event closes in 2 days, we recommend extending the event deadline to ensure all suppliers have sufficient time to submit their bids once the trust relationship is updated. If you continue to experience issues after following these steps, please provide the affected record IDs and the exact time of failure in UTC so we can investigate further.

Support Team
